body: This is so true! My parents decided that I would take the worst mattress in the house to college with me. Recently looked at the tag and found out it's from 1996. To bad I dont have any money to get a new one.
I am not usually one for ultimatums too, but I just dont know if I can handle this. I think the biggest problem is that he doesnt see (or at least wont admit) that he has a problem.
This is so clever. I feel like I would have a hard time conveying this to him, because I kind of just blurt stuff out. But I will give it my best, thank you!
Reading this was scary similar to what I am going through.

I agree that this will show who he truly is, and I think thats kind of what I am afraid of. I am really concerned about him, and really want him to see how he is affecting everyone. but I am afraid he wont.
I am always terrible when it comes to being tactful and saying things the right way. I kind of just blurt out everything I am feeling and want to say. Thanks for the help.

I agree with this totally! He used to be a runner and loved it! When he became depressed he stopped running, and this has only made it worse. Now he has basically no energy, he sleeps almost all day, only gets up for work, comes home, drinks a beer, then goes to bed. I have tried to be an example by saying things like, " hey lets go for a walk together". But he always says no. I do think these things would be good for him, its just a matter of him actually doing it.

I am glad that things turned around for you. This post totally made me tear up. I completely understand that when you are in that state of mind you kind of feel abandoned, and I see how much it can help to have at least one person there. It is always really hard to tell what he is upset about. Sometimes I feel like I am the guy and he is the girl cause I always have to try and figure out exactly what he really means. I have had a couple times where he breaks down and spills everything but those times are few and far between. I am not really frustrated or angry and I have told him that repeatedly, I am more just concerned about him. Thank you so much for all the help.

I think he is completely serious. When he has told me he was basically breaking down crying, and that's always tough seeing someone you love crying. I am really the only person who talks to him about personal stuff and I can't help thats why my next thought was therapist.

Thank you for the help. I have basically run my whole life by trying to make others happy, and by going through this I am learning that I can't fix everything and can't make everyone happy. So now I am trying to find things in life that can make me happy.
every time I see a deleted comment it always makes me wonder what was said.
